name: the 'Annotation' tooltipColumns entry falls through to the generic cell text
why: Without its own branch the Annotation is read by _artTooltipCellText(): one flattened line, and only the link text when the annotation has exactly one link. The card still shows something, so nothing looks broken at a glance.
grep: keeps the text around the link

name: the clone keeps the inline display:none of a collapsed wiki sub-section
why: _rewireNestedTableH2Toggles() collapses every nested <h2> section inside the cell by default. Copying that state into the card hides exactly the part the user asked to see in full.
grep: complete while the cell is clamped

name: filter highlights are copied into the card
why: The cell's highlight spans would be cloned with it, so the card would show the table's filter marks.

name: the bigbox card is not fitted to the window
why: The card has pointer-events:none and cannot scroll, so a long annotation runs off the bottom of the window with no hint that more exists.

name: the singleton card keeps the 600px width of the previous Annotation card
why: The tooltip div is shared by every artwork hover; without the per-hover reset one Annotation card leaves every later card wide.

edits.find:
// Singleton card: undo a previous Annotation card's widening.
                            _tip.style.maxWidth = '380px';

name: the inline-thumbnail card is not fitted to the window
why: The inline thumbnail has its own positioning code, so the strip's fit call does not cover it: a long annotation would run off the bottom of the window from the Name cell's thumbnail.
grep: inline thumbnail card is cut to the window
